challenge.method: Compared XML licenseId, name and crossRef field by field with JSON licenseId, name, crossRef[0].url and seeAlso[0]. Checked the destination against the publisher's canonical unit, edition title and legal-code filename.
challenge.results: All three values agree across the separate pins. The URL specifies legalcode within the zero/1.0 namespace. The publisher's plaintext uses legalcode.txt in that namespace and identifies the same edition. This resolves the Public Domain Mark and summary alternatives without treating the two URL resources as identical files.

limitations: The exact data commit is observable. The association of that commit with release 3.29.0 is supplied in the assessment scope. The detail record contains no release tag or build attestation.

XML and generated JSON belong to one SPDX data lineage. Their agreement supports field continuity. The crosswalk establishes neither representation equivalence, copyright classification, nor a grant for any project.
